transform_request_detect_websearch: transform a model response to detect and extract WebSearch tool_use or tool_calls blocks
transform_response_build_messages: transform search results into Anthropic or OpenAI assistant and user/tool messages for the agentic loop
format_search_response_text: format a SearchResponse into plain text with title, URL, and snippet for each result
detect_from_non_streaming_response: detect WebSearch tool_use blocks from a non-streaming Anthropic-style response
detect_from_openai_response: detect WebSearch tool_calls from an OpenAI-style response with function calls
